title: BIRDS: Characterizing and Understanding Biodiversity Impact of Large Language Model Serving
abstract: arXiv:2605.27480v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving creates environmental impacts beyond carbon and water, including ecosystem damage through biodiversity-related pathways. We present BIRDS, a framework for Biodiversity Impact of Request-Driven LLM Serving. BIRDS defines request-level functional units, quantifies operational and embodied biodiversity impact, and introduces Quality-Normalized Biodiversity Impact (QNBI) to jointly analyze ecological impact and response quality. Across diverse workloads, models, GPUs, and regions, BIRDS reveals that biodiversity impact accumulates at scale and exposes quality-aware serving tradeoffs. The code is available at https://github.com/TianyaoShi/BIRDS.

translated_title: BIRDS：刻画与理解大语言模型服务的生物多样性影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务产生的环境影响不仅限于碳排放和水资源消耗，还包括通过生物多样性相关途径造成的生态系统损害。我们提出了BIRDS，一个用于衡量请求驱动的大语言模型服务生物多样性影响的框架。BIRDS定义了请求级别的功能单元，量化了运营性和内含性（embodied）的生物多样性影响，并引入了质量归一化生物多样性影响（QNBI）指标，以联合分析生态影响与响应质量。在多种工作负载、模型、GPU和地区的实验中，BIRDS揭示了生物多样性影响会随规模不断累积，并展现了质量感知的服务权衡。代码已在 https://github.com/TianyaoShi/BIRDS 开源。
tldr: 提出了BIRDS框架，通过定义请求级功能单元和引入质量归一化生物多样性影响（QNBI）指标，首次系统量化了大语言模型服务对生物多样性的生态影响，并揭示了生态影响与响应质量之间的服务权衡。
en_tdlr: BIRDS is a framework that characterizes the biodiversity impact of request-driven LLM serving by defining request-level functional units and introducing Quality-Normalized Biodiversity Impact (QNBI), revealing how ecological impact accumulates at scale and exposing quality-aware serving tradeoffs.
